# Security Policy

## Supported versions

The `main` branch and the two most recent minor releases receive security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Email security@acme.example with a description of the issue, the affected versions, and
steps to reproduce. Do not open a public issue for security reports. You will receive a
tracking number on receipt.

## Response timeline

We acknowledge every report within 5 business days. Confirmed vulnerabilities receive a
remediation plan within 30 days of acknowledgement, and a coordinated disclosure date is
agreed with the reporter before any public advisory is published.

## Safe harbour

Good-faith research that follows this policy will not be subject to legal action by
Acme Corp.
